name: Katou Seiichi
source:
He's been living a lethargic life, but for some reason he moves to Shizuka's home village.

In the midst of the village's customs, he is swept up in a whirlpool of emotions she has never felt before, and gradually develops strong feelings.

However, there is a secret to his existence...

[From [url=http://www.sp-janis.com/speed/inen/]official site[/url]]
